summary: Frontend-only visual verification of redesigned home screen (/app/frontend/app/index.tsx). Loaded https://ea7f7918-2981-4e31-91c2-73ee9bacb960.preview.emergentagent.com at 414x900 viewport, waited 8s for entrance animations to settle, then queried DOM for every required testID and Arabic text fragment. ALL elements render correctly with opacity:1 and final transform (matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0) / none), confirming Animated.spring entrance animations DO complete on web preview. Tap navigation also verified for all three game cards and disabled state for soon-1.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' This is EXPECTED on Expo web preview (no RCTAnimation native module). Animations still run via JS driver and complete successfully (~600ms-1s). No user-visible impact. Cosmetic warning only.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Minor RN-web deprecation, no functional impact. Recommend moving pointerEvents="none" into the style object.
Console warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'textShadow* deprecated'. Pre-existing RN-web 0.76+ deprecations from other screens, not caused by this redesign.

rca_of_previous_blank_screen: Earlier blank/partial screenshots were almost certainly taken before JS-driver Animated.spring entrance animations finished. Because useNativeDriver falls back to JS on web, springs need ~600-1000ms to settle. The previous attempts likely captured during the initial frame when StatCard scale=0.85+translateY=30 and GameCard translateY=40 had not yet reached final values. Waiting 8s in this run produced fully settled, fully visible UI. NO code fix required; the design renders correctly. Recommendation for future testing: always wait >=4s after page load before screenshotting this screen.
action_items: (Optional, low priority) Move pointerEvents="none" from prop to style on FloatingBlob to silence RN-web deprecation warning.
(Informational) useNativeDriver warnings on web are harmless; can be suppressed by checking Platform.OS !== 'web' if desired, but no functional issue.
